whatThisPluginAdds.text: Notes adds private record notes with assignments, mentions, reminders, completion state, and an inbox for work needing attention.

surfaceOutcome.text: Admin users can add a note from supported records, assign colleagues, mention people, set reminders, and work through their Notes inbox.

developers.text: Note creation, visibility, assignment, reminders, and notifications are split into Actions behind a reusable Notes manager.

teams.text: Editors can coordinate follow-up beside the record being discussed without exposing internal notes on the public site.
